summary: port_forward built its kubectl command as one string and split it on spaces before spawn(), so a tool argument containing spaces smuggled extra kubectl flags (argument injection) even though no shell was involved.

safe.description: Arguments built as an array, one element per value

notes: Verified by diffing the published 3.4.0 and 3.5.0 tarballs (dist/tools/port_forward.js). 3.4.1 was never published. The rule reports this as CWE-78 command injection; argument injection (CWE-88) is the precise class. A message that names argument injection when the command comes from split() is a follow-up.
